dog.description_text:
Oreo is almost one year old and has plenty of puppy energy! She's an incredibly sweet and loving girl who enjoys spending time with her people. The outside world can still be a little scary, but with the help of her human friends, she's getting braver every day. She's selective about her dog friends and may need a little time to settle into a new home, but she has so much love to give!
All of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and up to date on vaccinations. Animals at our Manhattan location are available for same-day adoption. For animals at our Wantagh location or in foster care, please submit an online application at www.bideawee.org.
dog.name: Oreo
